parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more specific quantitative ties to the user's profile (monthly expense math, months-of-cash calculations, beta values, specific yield figures) and more concrete, executable instructions with specific dollar amounts and instruments. System B is solid and adds tax-sequencing value, but contains a few less-grounded claims (e.g., assuming JNJ drives the 30% Healthcare figure, recommending T whose dividend was cut) and slightly less precise actionability.
